outcomes_at_freeze: No proline-context contrast has been computed; structures and eligibility are selected before new score access
hypothesis: At initially non-Pro sites, the Pro-versus-comparator penalty is greater in geometrically regular internal TM helices than in matched non-helical non-TM loops, on average. This is a conditional functional hypothesis, not a universal pathogenicity law.
native_proline: Native Pro loss is a different mutation class and is excluded, never used as evidence that new Pro is harmless.
candidate_pool: Union of the prior Phase C experimental registry and the 13 fitted membrane accessions in the frozen manifest; no newly reserved experimental outcome is opened

structure_selection.source: Experimental X-ray or EM structures linked by UniProt
structure_selection.ranking: Greatest UniProt chain-range coverage, then best resolution, then PDB ID and chain ID
structure_selection.selection: First ranked structure with valid canonical mapping and usable geometry; report every failed attempt
structure_selection.mapping: Observed chain sequence aligned globally to canonical sequence; at least 95% identity over mapped residues; each eligible nine-residue window must match exactly
structure_selection.predicted_structures: Not pooled into the experimental-structure primary set

site_definition.common_window: Nine canonically contiguous, experimentally resolved native residues; no native Pro or Gly in the window
site_definition.regular_helix: Five central phi/psi pairs in [-100,-30] and [-80,-5] degrees, plus local C-alpha principal-axis bend at most 20 degrees across two five-residue windows
site_definition.tm_helix: Regular window wholly inside an annotated TM segment of at least 17 residues, with center at least four residues from each end
site_definition.coil_control: Outside all TM segments, 5-60 residues from a TM boundary, outside deposited helix/sheet ranges, central phi/psi neither alpha-helical nor beta-like nor positive-phi
site_definition.non_tm_helix: Regular helical window outside all TM segments; nondirectional diagnostic for ordinary helix sensitivity
site_definition.packing: Number of target-chain C-alpha contacts within 8 A excluding sequence neighbors within four residues; bins 0-3, 4-8, >=9
site_definition.limits: One resolved conformation and chain-only contacts do not establish all native conformations, lipid exposure or functional indispensability

contrast.primary: score(Pro) minus mean(score(A,I,L,M,V), excluding the native residue)
contrast.sensitivity: score(Pro) minus mean(score(S,T), excluding the native residue)
contrast.diagnostic: score(Pro) minus score(Gly); no universal ordering against a second helix-disrupting residue is asserted
contrast.complete_cases: Same positions across comparator analyses; all required missense scores must be finite; never impute missing alternatives
contrast.scale_check: Divide each position's contrast by its SD across all 19 measured missense alternatives; report missing/zero-spread positions separately

aggregation.context_difference: regular TM helix minus coil; harmonic cell-size weights within strata
aggregation.family_mapping: Existing frozen groups plus sequence-only local alignment at >=30% identity and >=50% coverage of both sequences, using the project's BLOSUM62/gap settings
aggregation.directional_verdict_minimum: Six independent groups; smaller samples retain descriptive estimates and intervals but no supported/opposite verdict
aggregation.power: These are feasibility limits, not a power guarantee

experimental_check.source: Previously inspected Phase C deposits, included human assays only, with their previously established score orientation
experimental_check.mapping: Canonical native identities verified; cross-species and unorientable deposits excluded
experimental_check.scaling: Within-assay average-tie rank-normalized damage before contrasts
experimental_check.claim: Development/replication evidence, not pristine new-protein confirmation
experimental_check.endpoint: Retain assay-specific expression/trafficking/stability endpoints; no clinical inference

interpretation.pass: Retain compliance as a positive control; do not invent a repair
interpretation.mixed: Comparator or scale sensitivity prevents an unqualified biological-failure claim
interpretation.opposite: Candidate discrepancy requiring independent endpoint evidence before any correction
interpretation.correction: Only consider a narrow Pro-introduction correction at eligible regular TM sites after experimental validation; re-audit positive-inside because neutral-comparator changes can move it
